title: Mexican Chicken Paella
description: A spicy twist on traditional Spanish paella, this Mexican-inspired dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner. Chicken, sausage, and vegetables come together in a flavorful and filling meal.

ingredients.name: Spanish chorizo
ingredients.notes: look for Mexican or Spanish chorizo for authentic flavor

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: smoked or sweet paprika works well

instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and tomato. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, paprika, and rice. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the pan from the heat and let rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the paella with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
